column1: # The stations a sealing measurement must have read.
# One label per line. These are the labels the measurement writes into its listing
# header (`# station <label> advertisements=<n>`), NOT hostnames: this repository is
# public, and which box is which is the fleet's business, not the register's. The
# operator maps labels to stations on the box that runs the measurement; the labels
# default to station-1..station-N in the order the seeds are given, so a run against
# the fleet's stations needs no arguments to line up with this file.
# WHY THIS EXISTS. A station answers a DHT read from the records IT holds, so one
# station is one replica set: an advertisement held only on another station's
# replicas never appears in a single-station listing, and a half-rolled service
# could read as sealed. check-sealing.sh fails when a label here is missing from the
# listing, or when it appears with nothing to show.
# Six, because the fleet runs six public stations. Change this file in the commit
# that changes the fleet, and the measurement cannot quietly shrink to one station.
station-1
station-2
station-3
station-4
station-5
station-6
